Credits

Project

DBD Surv Trainer is an unofficial, fan-made toolkit for survivors, combining timing-based practice trainers with in-match tools like map overlays and a 1v1 scoreboard/timer. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Behaviour Interactive in any way. Dead by Daylight and all related names are trademarks of Behaviour Interactive Inc.

Sound

Background music is generated live in your browser and is not a recording of any copyrighted track.

Map callouts

The clock-callout map layouts used in the Maps / Clocks module come from Hens' Callouts, used with Hens' kind permission.

hens333.com/callouts

1v1 Timer

Thanks to TulipErika for innovative ideas that shaped how the 1v1 Timer works, and for helping beta test the whole app.

TulipErika - Twitch

Built with

Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, using the Web Audio API for sound. No frameworks, no external services.

Privacy Policy
Plain-language summary — no legal team, just the truth about what happens to your data.

This app does not run a server, does not have a backend, and does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data to us or to anyone else.

What stays on your device

  • Training stats such as your best streak are saved using your browser's local storage, on your device only.
  • This data never leaves your device and is never sent anywhere.
  • Clearing your browser data or using a different browser/device will reset it.

Detect Map

The Detect Map feature captures a small region of your screen to read the map name. That screenshot is processed entirely on your own device (via a local OCR library) and is discarded immediately after — it is never saved, uploaded, or sent anywhere.

Fonts and third-party requests

This app loads fonts from Google Fonts. Loading a font may expose your IP address to Google, as with any external resource on the web. No other third-party service is used.

Cookies

This app does not use cookies or any tracking or analytics scripts.

Changes

If this policy ever changes, the update will be reflected on this page.

Terms of Service
By using this app, you agree to the following.

What this is

DBD Surv Trainer is a free, unofficial, fan-made set of practice tools for a video game. It is provided as-is, for personal training and entertainment purposes only.

No affiliation

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or connected in any way to Behaviour Interactive Inc. or Dead by Daylight. All game names, characters, and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

No warranty

This app is provided without any warranty of any kind. Timing values, in-game accuracy, and behavior may not perfectly match the actual game and are provided for training purposes only.

Use at your own discretion

You are responsible for how you use this app, including audio played through your device. If a tool doesn't work as expected, please just move on — no data is at risk since nothing is stored beyond your own device.

Changes

These terms may be updated as the project grows. Continued use of the app after changes means you accept the current version.
